# Cook'n With Class

> > Hands-on French cooking classes, wine tastings, and culinary experiences in Paris, Lyon, and Bordeaux, led by professional chefs including Brian Defehr from the Ritz Paris.

Cook'n With Class offers immersive culinary education through market-based cooking classes, wine pairing workshops with sommelier Anne Dumont, team building events, and online courses. The school operates ateliers in Paris, Lyon, and Bordeaux, and publishes French cookbooks including 'Les Marchés Français: Four Seasons of French Dishes from the Paris Markets.'

## Key Topics

- French cuisine and cooking techniques
- Paris market tours and seasonal recipes
- Wine tasting and food-wine pairing
- Hands-on cooking classes
- Team building culinary activities
- French desserts and pastries
- Chef Brian Defehr
- Sommelier Anne Dumont
- WSET wine education
- French cookbooks and recipe books
- Online cooking classes via Zoom
- Ateliers in Paris, Lyon, and Bordeaux
- Cheese and wine pairing
- Bread and macaron making

## Cooking Classes & Experiences

- [French Cooking Classes Paris - Cook'n with Class](https://cooknwithclass.com/french-cooking-classes-paris): Hands-on French cooking classes in Paris with market tours
- [Book Online Cooking Classes with Cook'n With Class - LIVE from France](https://cooknwithclass.com/book-online-cooking-classes): Live online cooking classes from France via Zoom - bread, macarons & more
- [Wine Classes Paris - Food & Wine Pairing Classes in Paris](https://cooknwithclass.com/wine-tasting-paris): Wine tasting & pairing classes in Paris with sommelier Anne Dumont
- [Activité de Team Building à Paris - Cook'n with Paris](https://cooknwithclass.com/team-building-cours-cuisine): Team building cooking classes in Paris, Lyon & Bordeaux

## Cookbooks & Recipe Resources

- [French Cookbook - Les Marchés Français: Four Seasons of French Dishes from the Paris Markets - Brian Defehr, Pauline Boldt](https://cooknwithclass.com/french-cookbook-les-marches-francais): Chef Brian Defehr's French cookbook featuring Paris market recipes
- [10 French Dessert Recipes You Should Stop Buying E-Book](https://cooknwithclass.com/product/10-french-dessert-recipes-for-beginners): E-book with essential French dessert recipes for beginners
